bio: Offering classic seafood cuisine, this restaurant serves the most well-known and loved dishes, from raw seafood to pasta and gnocchi with various sauces, and main dishes such as baked fish, fish stew, and salt-crusted fish. Of course, there are also fried dishes and fish soup (available by reservation). Everything is served in a lovely dining room with brick arches or, when the weather is nice, along the pedestrian street of the picturesque historic center....
